title: 35-language unlock via guarded NVRAM service tool
criterion: 33 locked language flags enabled after a sealed backup, read-back verified, calibration untouched, restore works

title: 29m59s limit + PAL/NTSC nag unlock
criterion: refused until verified property IDs exist
detail: The roadmap gives no property IDs for these flags. The tool refuses to guess; add a verified ID to nvram/registry.py (reviewed change) to enable them.

title: Picture Profile recipes + correct-exposure grey
criterion: 18% grey lands on each recipe's middle-grey level within 2%; recipe native ISOs match the DCG table

title: IMX410 dual conversion gain ('hidden dual native ISO')
criterion: shadow SNR at the HCG ISO beats the 'forbidden zone' ISO just below it (Cine4 640 > 500; S-Log3 5000 > 4000)
detail: Shadow patch (0.3% reflectance) at correct exposure for each ISO, measured pre-quantisation. The HCG ISO receives 22% less light than the ISO below it and still has the cleaner shadows.

title: HLG3 vs S-Log3 tonal density in an 8-bit pipeline
criterion: HLG3 spends more 8-bit code values per stop than S-Log3 across skin/midtones (-1.5..+1.5 EV)
detail: Larger display steps after the grade show up as visible banding on skin and skies.

title: FX3 colour match: ΔE2000 CCM + OKLab RBF -> 65³ LUT + DCTL
criterion: through the generated LUT: mean ΔE2000 < 1.5 over 24 patches and < 1.0 on skin patches (roadmap Phase 2 gate)
detail: Patches extracted from rendered 8-bit frames (HLG3 a7 III vs S-Log3 FX3-like reference).

title: 8-bit 4:2:0 -> float 4:4:4 joint-bilateral chroma reconstruction
criterion: chroma error after reconstruction is lower than plain nearest-neighbour upsampling

title: Sony PTP SDIO handshake + property control + live view
criterion: 3-phase handshake succeeds, settings round-trip, live view returns a JPEG and focus frames

title: External AI subject AF -> PTP Touch-AF -> native PDAF
criterion: subject eye stays inside the depth of field in >= 90% of frames after acquisition, vs a fixed AF point baseline
detail: Subject walks across frame; the fixed AF point (camera's own behaviour without subject tracking) loses them.

title: f/11 PDAF cutoff guard + hunting prevention
criterion: guard flags f/13 over PTP; CDAF beyond f/11 hunts measurably; AI steering is suppressed while PDAF is off

metrics.f13_message: PDAF DISABLED (f/13 > f/11) - add ND or switch to MF

title: 180° shutter-angle lock + 50/60 Hz anti-flicker
criterion: locked speeds render with < 0.5% row banding under AC light; the naive 180° speed under 50 Hz bands visibly
detail: The unlocked 29.97p case picks 1/60 s (179.8°), which is not a multiple of the 100 Hz light period.

title: Cine EI mode (ISO locked to native gain, EI shifts the monitor LUT)
criterion: PTP locks ISO 5000 (HCG) for S-Log3; rating EI 10000 lifts monitored grey by exactly +1 EV; recorded signal unchanged

title: EL-Zone style stop-based false colour
criterion: 18% grey maps to the middle-grey zone in every curve; +3.5 EV maps to 'bright highlight'

title: Automated focus bracketing over PTP + focus stacking
criterion: stack covers >= 90% of the frame at near-best sharpness; the best single frame covers far less

title: Cubic-Bézier rack focus over PTP near/far steps
criterion: lands exactly on target; eased (first tick < 1/3 of peak tick speed)

title: A7III-GyroShoe IMU + Gyroflow-style stabilisation (with RS correction)
criterion: IMU/video sync error < 10 ms with an unknown 370 ms START->record latency; frame-to-frame jitter reduced >= 4x
detail: Sync by signed per-axis cross-correlation of gyro rate against rotation recovered from optical flow; per-row correction uses the FF 4K readout time.

title: Rolling-shutter readout: Full-Frame 4K24 vs Super35 4K24
criterion: measured skew ratio S35/FF within 15% of 13.8/24.4 = 0.566 on a fast pan

title: Dynamic focus-breathing compensation
criterion: breathing model fitted from rendered frames; compensated subject size varies < 0.5% across the focus range

title: Focus map / depth-of-field visualiser
criterion: subject at the focus plane is classified in-focus, background behind, and the overlay is rendered

title: Anamorphic de-squeeze + multi-aspect guides
criterion: a 2x-squeezed capture is restored to within 4% of true proportions; 2.39:1 guide computed

title: Waveform, RGB parade, vectorscope, histogram
criterion: scopes render from live frames; the chart's skin patch lands near the vectorscope skin-tone line

title: Pre-capture video ring buffer (retroactive recording)
criterion: a take triggered late contains the buffered seconds before the trigger, encoded to ProRes 422 HQ
detail: 60 frames streamed before the trigger; buffer holds 2 s.

title: SMPTE LTC generator + jam-sync from the camera's audio track
criterion: decoding LTC recorded on the camera's right channel recovers the exact start timecode of video frame 0

title: 4-channel audio matrix: device sync, BWF timecode, clip repair
criterion: recorder synced to the sample; 4-ch BWF carries the start TC; clipped shout repaired from the -12 dB safety

title: Handheld multi-frame super-resolution
criterion: 12 tremor-shifted stills reconstructed at 2x beat single-frame upscaling by >= 3 dB PSNR against a true 2x render
detail: Pixels integrate light over their area (4x4 supersampled aperture).

title: Multi-frame noise / astro stacking
criterion: 16-frame sigma-clipped stack improves SNR by ~sqrt(16) = 4x (3.2x-4.8x)

title: Pre-capture burst (motion-triggered, with pre-roll)
criterion: trigger fires within 3 frames of the subject entering the ROI and the burst includes earlier frames

title: Verified dual-destination offload + manifests + proxies
criterion: every file copied to both drives, hash-verified, resumable, manifests re-verify, proxies generated

title: Cloud sync API: takes, presets, LUTs, sealed NVRAM backups
criterion: two desks converge on the same take list; tampered NVRAM backup rejected

title: A7III Control Desk end to end (PTP + AI AF + scopes + takes)
criterion: desk drives the simulated body over PTP, AI AF engages, every view and scope renders, a take is logged

title: Internal 10-bit 4:2:2, 4K60/120, HDMI RAW
criterion: documented silicon limits; not attempted
detail: The CXD90045 video encoder and HDMI transmitter are 8-bit, and IMX410 readout bandwidth caps full-width 4K at 30p. No software path changes this. The suite instead gets the most out of 8-bit: HLG3, 4:2:2 HDMI capture, float chroma reconstruction and dithering.
